tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm paper in light, deep road-asphalt green-black in dark.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: One step up from bg: sticky header, popovers, the selected mode. Separation by background step, not borders.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: One step down from bg: code lines, inputs, the road track, alternating bands.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on bg, bg-raised, bg-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table labels. Passes 4.5:1 on all three grounds.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text only: hairline numerals at display size, road dashes, disabled icons. Never body text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The rare hairline: table rows and the road edge. Prefer a background step first.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Milepost green, taken from highway mile-marker signs. Primary buttons, links, released money, the active milepost.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (buttons, milepost signs).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted accent ground: selected pills, the unawarded money colour, highlights behind a figure.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Road-paint yellow. Used sparingly: the testnet dot, the Sample data tag, attention markers. Text on it is signal-ink.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on signal.

tokens.name: money-unawarded
tokens.usage: Money square: in the budget, not yet awarded to anyone.

tokens.name: money-locked
tokens.usage: Money square: awarded but locked, waiting for a verifier's attestation.

tokens.name: money-released
tokens.usage: Money square: released to the payee after a valid proof.

tokens.name: money-refundable
tokens.usage: Money square: unpaid after the release window, going back to funders in proportion. Terracotta, distinct from accent in lightness too.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons. Always paired with a human sentence and 'Nothing was transferred'.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind an error panel.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px with 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero only. Clamp down to 44px at 360px wide.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: Most grant tools stop at selection.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Role entry lines, app page titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Each tranche unlocks only when a trusted verifier confirms a condition was met.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Reviewers set the amount. Verifiers unlock the payment.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Available only while the programme is Open.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: Stat tiles and big amounts. Tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between money squares; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical), list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; page gutter at 360px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page gutter on tablet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a landing section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between landing sections (64px on phone).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sq
tokens.usage: Money squares and the logo squares.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags, code lines.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, milepost signs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large bands and the hero road.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, phase badges, mode pills.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Sticky header and floating controls only.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, sign-in sheet, popovers.
